items.headline: Michael Carrick says Manchester United want and need more signings before window closes
items.summary: Michael Carrick stated the club require additional transfers before the September 1 deadline after signing Santos, Tielemans and Darlow.

items.headline: Manchester United complete summer signings of Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans
items.summary: United signed midfielder Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans for combined £85m, plus Karl Darlow on free transfer from Leeds.
